scope: Source-first selected Go/Python/Rust hub-retrieval and graph-consistency development check on already captured graphs. Source roles are not independent god-object defect labels or a representative sample.
reviewRules: Run the same public god_nodes(top_n=100) request on each frozen graph; report top-10, top-50 and top-100 prefixes without changing either output.

Join each preregistered witness to the exact graph declaration by repository-relative file, declaration start line and source symbol. A missing graph declaration is extraction unavailable, not a ranking miss.
Give retrieval credit only for an exact returned graph ID or a globally unique returned label with independently checked source identity. Ambiguous labels remain unresolved.
Recompute a returned row's distinct endpoint-pair degree on that tool's own graph. This checks graph consistency, not source correctness or semantic quality.

Keep source-role descriptions separate from god-object defect judgments. No source role, file length or high degree is a positive or negative defect label; do not compute god-object precision or superiority from this panel.
Retain raw requests, responses, transport errors, graph and source hashes, bounds and unavailable outcomes. Do not pool this selected panel with the Java MLCQ rating cohort.
